h1: Custom PL Putty for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom PL putty in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for stress relief and branding. Soft CTA for quotes.
introHtml: Custom PL putty offers a unique tactile experience for stress relief and focus, making it a popular giveaway for trade shows and employee wellness programs. Unlike standard putty, PL putty is formulated for a non-greasy, smooth texture that resists sticking to hands. Decorate it with your logo in vibrant colors to create a memorable branded item that recipients will keep at their desk. Perfect for marketing directors and HR managers seeking a low-cost, high-engagement promotional product.
heroAltText: Custom PL putty in blue with a company logo, used for stress relief and branding
